inputs.name: projectPath
inputs.description: Absolute path to the selected project root, used only as a temporary working directory.

inputs.name: repositoryPath
inputs.description: Resolved repository identity hint for the selected project. Never treated as the Community Packages write target.

inputs.name: communityTaskName
inputs.description: Human readable name of the Community Task to author. Drives the canonical kebab-case task id and store-page title.

inputs.name: communityTaskObjective
inputs.description: Objective and user value of the Community Task being authored.

inputs.name: communityTaskInputs
inputs.description: Panel input fields and constraints the authored Community Task must collect.

inputs.name: communityTaskQuality
inputs.description: Execution behavior and quality requirements the authored prompt templates must enforce.

inputs.name: communityTaskAcceptance
inputs.description: Acceptance criteria that decide whether the authored Community Task package is complete.

inputs.name: communityTaskPublication
inputs.description: Optional publication notes: catalog, tags, best-fit scenarios, and store-page framing.

inputs.name: targetScopeMarkdown
inputs.description: Frontend-composed markdown scope block built from the selected read-only repositories and their access labels.

inputs.name: targetRepositories
inputs.description: Optional read-only repositories resolved from the preset task selection.

inputs.name: referenceVaults
inputs.description: Optional supplemental vault references resolved from the preset task selection.

inputs.name: targetProjects
inputs.description: Optional supplemental cross-project references resolved from the preset task selection.
